'''Blir'''' was a [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked under the direction of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ellin Lah]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] on the cargo ship ''[[Woebegone]]''. He belonged to a group of traders who traveled through the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]], where it supplied several worlds with seafood.

==Biography==
In the year [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Blir and his comrades set out on a journey to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] after they realized a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] hid as a stowaway on the ''Woebegone''. The Muun was known to be [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and he ordered Blir and the crew to take him back to his homeworld. Blir and the crew rejected his offer, whereupon the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was a tendency to forcibly take control of the spacecraft. Blir and all the crew members were killed by the Sith Lord.
